passages.label: Mart. 3.1.1
passages.text: Hoc tibi quidquid id est longinquis mittit ab oris

passages.label: Mart. 3.1.2
passages.text: Gallia Romanae nomine dicta togae.

passages.label: Mart. 3.1.3
passages.text: Hunc legis et laudas librum fortasse priorem:

passages.label: Mart. 3.1.4
passages.text: Illa vel haec mea sunt, quae meliora putas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.1.5
passages.text: Plus sane placeat domina qui natus in urbe est:

passages.label: Mart. 3.1.6
passages.text: Debet enim Gallum vincere verna liber.

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.1
passages.text: Cuius vis fieri, libelle, munus?

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.2
passages.text: Festina tibi vindicem parare,

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.3
passages.text: Ne nigram cito raptus in culinam

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.4
passages.text: Cordylas madida tegas papyro

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.5
passages.text: Vel turis piperisve sis cucullus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.6
passages.text: Faustini fugis in sinum? sapisti.

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.7
passages.text: Cedro nunc licet ambules perunctus

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.8
passages.text: Et frontis gemino decens honore

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.9
passages.text: Pictis luxurieris umbilicis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.10
passages.text: Et te purpura delicata velet,

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.11
passages.text: Et cocco rubeat superbus index.

passages.label: Mart. 3.2.12
passages.text: Illo vindice nec Probum timeto.

passages.label: Mart. 3.3.1
passages.text: [Formonsam faciem nigro medicamine celas,

passages.label: Mart. 3.3.2
passages.text: Sed non formonso corpore laedis aquas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.3.3
passages.text: Ipsam crede deam verbis tibi dicere nostris:

passages.label: Mart. 3.3.4
passages.text: 'Aut aperi faciem, aut tunicata lava.']

passages.label: Mart. 3.4.1
passages.text: Romam vade, liber: si, veneris unde, requiret,

passages.label: Mart. 3.4.2
passages.text: Aemiliae dices de regione viae.

passages.label: Mart. 3.4.3
passages.text: Si, quibus in terris, qua simus in urbe, rogabit,

passages.label: Mart. 3.4.4
passages.text: Corneli referas me licet esse Foro.

passages.label: Mart. 3.4.5
passages.text: Cur absim, quaeret: breviter tu multa fatere:

passages.label: Mart. 3.4.6
passages.text: 'Non poterat vanae taedia ferre togae.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.4.7
passages.text: 'Quando venit?' dicet: tu respondeto: 'Poeta

passages.label: Mart. 3.4.8
passages.text: Exierat: veniet, cum citharoedus erit.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.1
passages.text: Vis commendari sine me cursurus in urbem,

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.2
passages.text: Parve liber, multis, an satis unus erit?

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.3
passages.text: Unus erit, mihi crede, satis, cui non eris hospes,

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.4
passages.text: Iulius, assiduum nomen in ore meo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.5
passages.text: Protinus hunc primae quaeres in limine Tectae:

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.6
passages.text: Quos tenuit Daphnis, nunc tenet ille lares.

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.7
passages.text: Est illi coniunx, quae te manibusque sinuque

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.8
passages.text: Excipiet, tu vel pulverulentus eas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.9
passages.text: Hos tu seu pariter sive hanc illumve priorem

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.10
passages.text: Videris, hoc dices 'Marcus havere iubet,'

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.11
passages.text: Et satis est: alios commendet epistula: peccat

passages.label: Mart. 3.5.12
passages.text: Qui commendandum se putat esse suis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.6.1
passages.text: Lux tibi post Idus numeratur tertia Maias,

passages.label: Mart. 3.6.2
passages.text: Marcelline, tuis bis celebranda sacris.

passages.label: Mart. 3.6.3
passages.text: Inputat aetherios ortus haec prima parenti,

passages.label: Mart. 3.6.4
passages.text: Libat florentes haec tibi prima genas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.6.5
passages.text: Magna licet dederit iucundae munera vitae,

passages.label: Mart. 3.6.6
passages.text: Plus numquam patri praestitit ille dies.

passages.label: Mart. 3.7.1
passages.text: Centum miselli iam valete quadrantes,

passages.label: Mart. 3.7.2
passages.text: Anteambulonis congiarium lassi,

passages.label: Mart. 3.7.3
passages.text: Quos dividebat balneator elixus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.7.4
passages.text: Quid cogitatis, o fames amicorum?

passages.label: Mart. 3.7.5
passages.text: Regis superbi sportulae recesserunt.

passages.label: Mart. 3.7.6
passages.text: 'Nihil stropharum est: iam salarium dandum est.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.8.1
passages.text: 'Thai+da Quintus amat.' Quam Thai+da? 'Thai+da luscam.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.8.2
passages.text: Unum oculum Thai+s non habet, ille duos.

passages.label: Mart. 3.9.1
passages.text: Versiculos in me narratur scribere Cinna.

passages.label: Mart. 3.9.2
passages.text: Non scribit, cuius carmina nemo legit.

passages.label: Mart. 3.10.1
passages.text: Constituit, Philomuse, pater tibi milia bina

passages.label: Mart. 3.10.2
passages.text: Menstrua perque omnis praestitit illa dies,

passages.label: Mart. 3.10.3
passages.text: Luxuriam premeret cum crastina semper egestas

passages.label: Mart. 3.10.4
passages.text: Et vitiis essent danda diurna tuis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.10.5
passages.text: Idem te moriens heredem ex asse reliquit.

passages.label: Mart. 3.10.6
passages.text: Exheredavit te, Philomuse, pater.

passages.label: Mart. 3.11.1
passages.text: Si tua nec Thai+s nec lusca est, Quinte, puella,

passages.label: Mart. 3.11.2
passages.text: Cur in te factum distichon esse putas?

passages.label: Mart. 3.11.3
passages.text: Sed similest aliquid? pro Laide Thai+da dixi?

passages.label: Mart. 3.11.4
passages.text: Dic mihi, quid simile est Thai+s et Hermione?

passages.label: Mart. 3.11.5
passages.text: Tu tamen es Quintus: mutemus nomen amantis:

passages.label: Mart. 3.11.6
passages.text: Si non vult Quintus, Thai+da Sextus amet.

passages.label: Mart. 3.12.1
passages.text: Unguentum, fateor, bonum dedisti

passages.label: Mart. 3.12.2
passages.text: Convivis here, sed nihil scidisti.

passages.label: Mart. 3.12.3
passages.text: Res salsa est bene olere et esurire.

passages.label: Mart. 3.12.4
passages.text: Qui non cenat et unguitur, Fabulle,

passages.label: Mart. 3.12.5
passages.text: Hic vere mihi mortuus videtur.

passages.label: Mart. 3.13.1
passages.text: Dum non vis pisces, dum non vis carpere pullos

passages.label: Mart. 3.13.2
passages.text: Et plus quam putri, Naevia, parcis apro,

passages.label: Mart. 3.13.3
passages.text: Accusas rumpisque cocum, tamquam omnia cruda

passages.label: Mart. 3.13.4
passages.text: Attulerit. Numquam sic ego crudus ero.

passages.label: Mart. 3.14.1
passages.text: Romam petebat esuritor Tuccius

passages.label: Mart. 3.14.2
passages.text: Profectus ex Hispania.

passages.label: Mart. 3.14.3
passages.text: Occurrit illi sportularum fabula:

passages.label: Mart. 3.14.4
passages.text: A ponte rediit Mulvio.

passages.label: Mart. 3.15.1
passages.text: Plus credit nemo tota quam Cordus in urbe.

passages.label: Mart. 3.15.2
passages.text: 'Cum sit tam pauper, quomodo?' Caecus amat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.16.1
passages.text: Das gladiatores, sutorum regule, Cerdo,

passages.label: Mart. 3.16.2
passages.text: Quodque tibi tribuit subula, sica rapit.

passages.label: Mart. 3.16.3
passages.text: Ebrius es: neque enim faceres hoc sobrius umquam,

passages.label: Mart. 3.16.4
passages.text: Ut velles corio ludere, Cerdo, tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.16.5
passages.text: Lusisti corio: sed te, mihi crede, memento

passages.label: Mart. 3.16.6
passages.text: Nunc in pellicula, Cerdo, tenere tua.

passages.label: Mart. 3.17.1
passages.text: Circumlata diu mensis scribilita secundis

passages.label: Mart. 3.17.2
passages.text: Urebat nimio saeva calore manus;

passages.label: Mart. 3.17.3
passages.text: Sed magis ardebat Sabidi gula: protinus ergo

passages.label: Mart. 3.17.4
passages.text: Sufflavit buccis terque quaterque suis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.17.5
passages.text: Illa quidem tepuit digitosque admittere visa est,

passages.label: Mart. 3.17.6
passages.text: Sed nemo potuit tangere: merda fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 3.18.1
passages.text: Perfrixisse tuas questa est praefatio fauces.

passages.label: Mart. 3.18.2
passages.text: Cum te excusaris, Maxime, quid recitas?

passages.label: Mart. 3.19.1
passages.text: Proxima centenis ostenditur ursa columnis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.19.2
passages.text: Exornant fictae qua platanona ferae.

passages.label: Mart. 3.19.3
passages.text: Huius dum patulos adludens temptat hiatus

passages.label: Mart. 3.19.4
passages.text: Pulcher Hylas, teneram mersit in ora manum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.19.5
passages.text: Vipera sed caeco scelerata latebat in aere

passages.label: Mart. 3.19.6
passages.text: Vivebatque anima deteriore fera.

passages.label: Mart. 3.19.7
passages.text: Non sensit puer esse dolos, nisi dente recepto.

passages.label: Mart. 3.19.8
passages.text: Dum perit. O facinus, falsa quod ursa fuit!

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.1
passages.text: Dic, Musa, quid agat Canius meus Rufus:

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.2
passages.text: Utrumne chartis tradit ille victuris

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.3
passages.text: Legenda temporum acta Claudianorum?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.4
passages.text: An quae Neroni falsus astruit scriptor?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.5
passages.text: An aemulatur inprobi λόγουσ Phaedri?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.6
passages.text: Lascivus elegis an severus herois?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.7
passages.text: An in coturnis horridus Sophocleis?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.8
passages.text: An otiosus in schola poetarum

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.9
passages.text: Lepore tinctos Attico sales narrat?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.10
passages.text: Hinc si recessit, porticum terit †templi

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.11
passages.text: An spatia carpit lentus Argonautarum?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.12
passages.text: An delicatae sole rursus Europae

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.13
passages.text: Inter tepentes post meridie buxos

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.14
passages.text: Sedet ambulatve liber acribus curis?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.15
passages.text: Titine thermis an lavatur Agrippae

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.16
passages.text: An inpudici balneo Tigillini?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.17
passages.text: An rure Tulli fruitur atque Lucani?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.18
passages.text: An Pollionis dulce currit ad quartum?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.19
passages.text: An aestuantis iam profectus ad Baias

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.20
passages.text: Piger Lucrino nauculatur in stagno?

passages.label: Mart. 3.20.21
passages.text: 'Vis scire quid agat Canius tuus? Ridet.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.21.1
passages.text: Proscriptum famulus servavit fronte notatus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.21.2
passages.text: Non fuit haec domini vita, sed invidia.

passages.label: Mart. 3.22.1
passages.text: Dederas, Apici, bis trecenties ventri,

passages.label: Mart. 3.22.2
passages.text: Et adhuc supererat centies tibi laxum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.22.3
passages.text: Hoc tu gravatus ut famem et sitim ferre

passages.label: Mart. 3.22.4
passages.text: Summa venenum potione perduxti.

passages.label: Mart. 3.22.5
passages.text: Nihil est, Apici, tibi gulosius factum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.23.1
passages.text: Omnia cum retro pueris obsonia tradas,

passages.label: Mart. 3.23.2
passages.text: Cur non mensa tibi ponitur a pedibus?

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.1
passages.text: Vite nocens rosa stabat moriturus ad aras

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.2
passages.text: Hircus, Bacche, tuis victima grata focis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.3
passages.text: Quem Tuscus mactare deo cum vellet haruspex,

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.4
passages.text: Dixerat agresti forte rudique viro,

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.5
passages.text: Ut cito testiculos et acuta falce secaret,

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.6
passages.text: Taeter ut immundae carnis abiret odor.

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.7
passages.text: Ipse super virides aras luctantia pronus

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.8
passages.text: Dum resecat cultro colla premitque manu,

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.9
passages.text: Ingens iratis apparuit hirnea sacris.

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.10
passages.text: Occupat hanc ferro rusticus atque secat,

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.11
passages.text: Hoc ratus antiquos sacrorum poscere ritus

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.12
passages.text: Talibus et fibris numina prisca coli.

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.13
passages.text: Sic, modo qui Tuscus fueras, nunc Gallus haruspex,

passages.label: Mart. 3.24.14
passages.text: Dum iugulas hircum, factus es ipse caper.

passages.label: Mart. 3.25.1
passages.text: Si temperari balneum cupis fervens,

passages.label: Mart. 3.25.2
passages.text: Faustine, quod vix Iulianus intraret,

passages.label: Mart. 3.25.3
passages.text: Roga, lavetur, rhetorem Sabineium.

passages.label: Mart. 3.25.4
passages.text: Neronianas is refrigerat thermas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.26.1
passages.text: Praedia solus habes et solus, Candide, nummos,

passages.label: Mart. 3.26.2
passages.text: Aurea solus habes, murrina solus habes,

passages.label: Mart. 3.26.3
passages.text: Massica solus habes et Opimi Caecuba solus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.26.4
passages.text: Et cor solus habes, solus et ingenium.

passages.label: Mart. 3.26.5
passages.text: Omnia solus habes—hoc me puta velle negare!—

passages.label: Mart. 3.26.6
passages.text: Uxorem sed habes, Candide, cum populo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.27.1
passages.text: Numquam me revocas, venias cum saepe vocatus:

passages.label: Mart. 3.27.2
passages.text: Ignosco, nullum si modo, Galle, vocas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.27.3
passages.text: Invitas alios: vitium est utriusque. 'Quod?' inquis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.27.4
passages.text: Et mihi cor non est, et tibi, Galle, pudor.

passages.label: Mart. 3.28.1
passages.text: Auriculam Mario graviter miraris olere.

passages.label: Mart. 3.28.2
passages.text: Tu facis hoc: garris, Nestor, in auriculam.

passages.label: Mart. 3.29.1
passages.text: Has cum gemina compede dedicat catenas,

passages.label: Mart. 3.29.2
passages.text: Saturne, tibi Zoilus, anulos priores.

passages.label: Mart. 3.30.1
passages.text: Sportula nulla datur; gratis conviva recumbis:

passages.label: Mart. 3.30.2
passages.text: Dic mihi, quid Romae, Gargiliane, facis?

passages.label: Mart. 3.30.3
passages.text: Unde tibi togula est et fuscae pensio cellae?

passages.label: Mart. 3.30.4
passages.text: Unde datur quadrans? unde vir es Chiones?

passages.label: Mart. 3.30.5
passages.text: Cum ratione licet dicas te vivere summa,

passages.label: Mart. 3.30.6
passages.text: Quod vivis, nulla cum ratione facis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.31.1
passages.text: Sunt tibi, confiteor, diffusi iugera campi

passages.label: Mart. 3.31.2
passages.text: Urbanique tenent praedia multa lares,

passages.label: Mart. 3.31.3
passages.text: Et servit dominae numerosus debitor arcae

passages.label: Mart. 3.31.4
passages.text: Sustentatque tuas aurea massa dapes.

passages.label: Mart. 3.31.5
passages.text: Fastidire tamen noli, Rufine, minores:

passages.label: Mart. 3.31.6
passages.text: Plus habuit Didymos, plus Philomelus habet.

passages.label: Mart. 3.32.1
passages.text: Non possum vetulam. Quereris, Matrinia? possum

passages.label: Mart. 3.32.2
passages.text: Et vetulam, sed tu mortua, non vetula es.

passages.label: Mart. 3.32.3
passages.text: Possum Hecubam, possum Niobam, Matrinia, sed si

passages.label: Mart. 3.32.4
passages.text: Nondum erit illa canis, nondum erit illa lapis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.33.1
passages.text: Ingenuam malo, sed si tamen illa negetur,

passages.label: Mart. 3.33.2
passages.text: Libertina mihi proxuma condicio est:

passages.label: Mart. 3.33.3
passages.text: Extremo est ancilla loco: sed vincet utramque,

passages.label: Mart. 3.33.4
passages.text: Si facie nobis haec erit ingenua.

passages.label: Mart. 3.34.1
passages.text: Digna tuo cur sis indignaque nomine, dicam.

passages.label: Mart. 3.34.2
passages.text: Frigida es et nigra es: non es et es Chione.

passages.label: Mart. 3.35.1
passages.text: Artis Phidiacae toreuma clarum

passages.label: Mart. 3.35.2
passages.text: Pisces aspicis: adde aquam, natabunt.

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.1
passages.text: Quod novus et nuper factus tibi praestat amicus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.2
passages.text: Hoc praestare iubes me, Fabiane, tibi:

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.3
passages.text: Horridus ut primo semper te mane salutem

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.4
passages.text: Per mediumque trahat me tua sella lutum,

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.5
passages.text: Lassus ut in thermas decuma vel serius hora

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.6
passages.text: Te sequar Agrippae, cum laver ipse Titi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.7
passages.text: Hoc per triginta merui, Fabiane, Decembres,

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.8
passages.text: Ut sim tiro tuae semper amicitiae?

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.9
passages.text: Hoc merui, Fabiane, toga tritaque meaque,

passages.label: Mart. 3.36.10
passages.text: Ut nondum credas me meruisse rudem?

passages.label: Mart. 3.37.1
passages.text: Irasci tantum felices nostis amici.

passages.label: Mart. 3.37.2
passages.text: Non belle facitis, sed iuvat hoc: facite.

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.1
passages.text: Quae te causa trahit vel quae fiducia Romam,

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.2
passages.text: Sexte? quid aut speras aut petis inde? refer.

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.3
passages.text: 'Causas' inquis 'agam Cicerone disertior ipso

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.4
passages.text: Atque erit in triplici par mihi nemo foro.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.5
passages.text: Egit Atestinus causas et Civis—utrumque

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.6
passages.text: Noras—; sed neutri pensio tota fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.7
passages.text: 'Si nihil hinc veniet, pangentur carmina nobis:

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.8
passages.text: Audieris, dices esse Maronis opus.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.9
passages.text: Insanis: omnes gelidis quicumque lacernis

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.10
passages.text: Sunt ibi, Nasones Vergiliosque vides.

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.11
passages.text: 'Atria magna colam.' Vix tres aut quattuor ista

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.12
passages.text: Res aluit, pallet cetera turba fame.

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.13
passages.text: 'Quid faciam? suade: nam certum est vivere Romae.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.38.14
passages.text: Si bonus es, casu vivere, Sexte, potes.

passages.label: Mart. 3.39.1
passages.text: Iliaco similem puerum, Faustine, ministro

passages.label: Mart. 3.39.2
passages.text: Lusca Lycoris amat. Quam bene lusca videt!

passages.label: Mart. 3.40.1
passages.text: Inserta phialae Mentoris manu ducta

passages.label: Mart. 3.40.2
passages.text: Lacerta vivit et timetur argentum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.41.1
passages.text: Mutua quod nobis ter quinquagena dedisti

passages.label: Mart. 3.41.2
passages.text: Ex opibus tantis, quas gravis arca premit,

passages.label: Mart. 3.41.3
passages.text: Esse tibi magnus, Telesine, videris amicus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.41.4
passages.text: Tu magnus, quod das? immo ego, quod recipis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.42.1
passages.text: Lomento rugas uteri quod condere temptas,

passages.label: Mart. 3.42.2
passages.text: Polla, tibi ventrem, non mihi labra linis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.42.3
passages.text: Simpliciter pateat vitium fortasse pusillum:

passages.label: Mart. 3.42.4
passages.text: Quod tegitur, magnum creditur esse malum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.43.1
passages.text: Mentiris iuvenem tinctis, Laetine, capillis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.43.2
passages.text: Tam subito corvus, qui modo cycnus eras.

passages.label: Mart. 3.43.3
passages.text: Non omnes fallis; scit te Proserpina canum:

passages.label: Mart. 3.43.4
passages.text: Personam capiti detrahet illa tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.1
passages.text: Occurrit tibi nemo quod libenter,

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.2
passages.text: Quod, quacumque venis, fuga est et ingens

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.3
passages.text: Circa te, Ligurine, solitudo,

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.4
passages.text: Quid sit, scire cupis? Nimis poeta es.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.5
passages.text: Hoc valde vitium periculosum est.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.6
passages.text: Non tigris catulis citata raptis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.7
passages.text: Non dipsas medio perusta sole,

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.8
passages.text: Nec sic scorpios inprobus timetur.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.9
passages.text: Nam tantos, rogo, quis ferat labores?

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.10
passages.text: Et stanti legis et legis sedenti,

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.11
passages.text: Currenti legis et legis cacanti.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.12
passages.text: In thermas fugio: sonas ad aurem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.13
passages.text: Piscinam peto: non licet natare.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.14
passages.text: Ad cenam propero: tenes euntem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.15
passages.text: Ad cenam venio: fugas sedentem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.16
passages.text: Lassus dormio: suscitas iacentem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.17
passages.text: Vis, quantum facias mali, videre?

passages.label: Mart. 3.44.18
passages.text: Vir iustus, probus, innocens timeris.

passages.label: Mart. 3.45.1
passages.text: Fugerit an Phoebus mensas cenamque Thyestae

passages.label: Mart. 3.45.2
passages.text: Ignoro: fugimus nos, Ligurine, tuam.

passages.label: Mart. 3.45.3
passages.text: Illa quidem lauta est dapibusque instructa superbis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.45.4
passages.text: Sed nihil omnino te recitante placet.

passages.label: Mart. 3.45.5
passages.text: Nolo mihi ponas rhombos mullumve bilibrem,

passages.label: Mart. 3.45.6
passages.text: Nec volo boletos, ostrea nolo: tace.

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.1
passages.text: Exigis a nobis operam sine fine togatam:

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.2
passages.text: Non eo, libertum sed tibi mitto meum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.3
passages.text: 'Non est' inquis 'idem.' Multo plus esse probabo:

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.4
passages.text: Vix ego lecticam subsequar, ille feret.

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.5
passages.text: In turbam incideris, cunctos umbone repellet:

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.6
passages.text: Invalidum est nobis ingenuumque latus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.7
passages.text: Quidlibet in causa narraveris, ipse tacebo:

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.8
passages.text: At tibi tergeminum mugiet ille sophos.

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.9
passages.text: Lis erit, ingenti faciet convicia voce:

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.10
passages.text: Esse pudor vetuit fortia verba mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.11
passages.text: 'Ergo nihil nobis' inquis 'praestabis amicus?'

passages.label: Mart. 3.46.12
passages.text: Quidquid libertus, Candide, non poterit.

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.1
passages.text: Capena grandi porta qua pluit gutta

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.2
passages.text: Phrygiumque Matris Almo qua lavat ferrum,

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.3
passages.text: Horatiorum qua viret sacer campus

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.4
passages.text: Et qua pusilli fervet Herculis fanum,

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.5
passages.text: Faustine, plena Bassus ibat in raeda,

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.6
passages.text: Omnis beati copias trahens ruris.

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.7
passages.text: Illic videres frutice nobili caules

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.8
passages.text: Et utrumque porrum sessilesque lactucas

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.9
passages.text: Pigroque ventri non inutiles betas,

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.10
passages.text: Illic coronam pinguibus gravem turdis

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.11
passages.text: Leporemque laesum Gallici canis dente

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.12
passages.text: Nondumque victa lacteum faba porcum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.13
passages.text: Nec feriatus ibat ante carrucam,

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.14
passages.text: Sed tuta faeno cursor ova portabat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.47.15
passages.text: Urbem petebat Bassus? immo rus ibat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.48.1
passages.text: Pauperis extruxit cellam, sed vendidit Olus

passages.label: Mart. 3.48.2
passages.text: Praedia: nunc cellam pauperis Olus habet.

passages.label: Mart. 3.49.1
passages.text: Veientana mihi misces, ubi Massica potas:

passages.label: Mart. 3.49.2
passages.text: Olfacere haec malo pocula, quam bibere.

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.1
passages.text: Haec tibi, non alia, est ad cenam causa vocandi,

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.2
passages.text: Versiculos recites ut, Ligurine, tuos.

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.3
passages.text: Deposui soleas, adfertur protinus ingens

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.4
passages.text: Inter lactucas oxygarumque liber:

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.5
passages.text: Alter perlegitur, dum fercula prima morantur:

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.6
passages.text: Tertius est, nec adhuc mensa secunda venit:

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.7
passages.text: Et quartum recitas et quintum denique librum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.8
passages.text: Putidus est, totiens si mihi ponis aprum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.9
passages.text: Quod si non scombris scelerata poemata donas,

passages.label: Mart. 3.50.10
passages.text: Cenabis solus iam, Ligurine, domi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.51.1
passages.text: Cum faciem laudo, cum miror crura manusque,

passages.label: Mart. 3.51.2
passages.text: Dicere, Galla, soles 'Nuda placebo magis,'

passages.label: Mart. 3.51.3
passages.text: Et semper vitas communia balnea nobis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.51.4
passages.text: Numquid, Galla, times, ne tibi non placeam?

passages.label: Mart. 3.52.1
passages.text: Empta domus fuerat tibi, Tongiliane, ducentis:

passages.label: Mart. 3.52.2
passages.text: Abstulit hanc nimium casus in urbe frequens.

passages.label: Mart. 3.52.3
passages.text: Conlatum est deciens. Rogo, non potes ipse videri

passages.label: Mart. 3.52.4
passages.text: Incendisse tuam, Tongiliane, domum?

passages.label: Mart. 3.53.1
passages.text: Et voltu poteram tuo carere

passages.label: Mart. 3.53.2
passages.text: Et collo manibusque cruribusque

passages.label: Mart. 3.53.3
passages.text: Et mammis natibusque clunibusque,

passages.label: Mart. 3.53.4
passages.text: Et, ne singula persequi laborem,

passages.label: Mart. 3.53.5
passages.text: Tota te poteram, Chloe, carere.

passages.label: Mart. 3.54.1
passages.text: Cum dare non possim quod poscis, Galla, rogantem,

passages.label: Mart. 3.54.2
passages.text: Multo simplicius, Galla, negare potes.

passages.label: Mart. 3.55.1
passages.text: Quod quacumque venis, Cosmum migrare putamus

passages.label: Mart. 3.55.2
passages.text: Et fluere excusso cinnama fusa vitro,

passages.label: Mart. 3.55.3
passages.text: Nolo peregrinis placeas tibi, Gellia, nugis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.55.4
passages.text: Scis, puto, posse meum sic bene olere canem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.56.1
passages.text: Sit cisterna mihi, quam vinea, malo Ravennae,

passages.label: Mart. 3.56.2
passages.text: Cum possim multo vendere pluris aquam.

passages.label: Mart. 3.57.1
passages.text: Callidus inposuit nuper mihi copo Ravennae:

passages.label: Mart. 3.57.2
passages.text: Cum peterem mixtum, vendidit ille merum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.1
passages.text: Baiana nostri villa, Basse, Faustini

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.2
passages.text: Non otiosis ordinata myrtetis

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.3
passages.text: Viduaque platano tonsilique buxeto

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.4
passages.text: Ingrata lati spatia detinet campi,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.5
passages.text: Sed rure vero barbaroque laetatur.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.6
passages.text: Hic farta premitur angulo Ceres omni

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.7
passages.text: Et multa fragrat testa senibus autumnis;

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.8
passages.text: Hic post Novembres imminente iam bruma

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.9
passages.text: Seras putator horridus refert uvas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.10
passages.text: Truces in alta valle mugiunt tauri

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.11
passages.text: Vitulusque inermi fronte prurit in pugnam.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.12
passages.text: Vagatur omnis turba sordidae chortis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.13
passages.text: Argutus anser gemmeique pavones

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.14
passages.text: Nomenque debet quae rubentibus pinnis

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.15
passages.text: Et picta perdix Numidicaeque guttatae

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.16
passages.text: Et impiorum phasiana Colchorum;

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.17
passages.text: Rhodias superbi feminas premunt galli;

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.18
passages.text: Sonantque turres plausibus columbarum,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.19
passages.text: Gemit hinc palumbus, inde cereus turtur.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.20
passages.text: Avidi secuntur vilicae sinum porci

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.21
passages.text: Matremque plenam mollis agnus expectat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.22
passages.text: Cingunt serenum lactei focum vernae

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.23
passages.text: Et larga festos lucet ad lares silva.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.24
passages.text: Non segnis albo pallet otio caupo,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.25
passages.text: Nec perdit oleum lubricus palaestrita,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.26
passages.text: Sed tendit avidis rete subdolum turdis

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.27
passages.text: Tremulave captum linea trahit piscem

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.28
passages.text: Aut inpeditam cassibus refert dammam;

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.29
passages.text: Exercet hilares facilis hortus urbanos,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.30
passages.text: Et paedagogo non iubente lascivi

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.31
passages.text: Parere gaudent vilico capillati,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.32
passages.text: Et delicatus opere fruitur eunuchus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.33
passages.text: Nec venit inanis rusticus salutator:

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.34
passages.text: Fert ille ceris cana cum suis mella

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.35
passages.text: Metamque lactis Sassinate de silva;

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.36
passages.text: Somniculosos ille porrigit glires,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.37
passages.text: Hic vagientem matris hispidae fetum,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.38
passages.text: Alius coactos non amare capones.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.39
passages.text: Et dona matrum vimine offerunt texto

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.40
passages.text: Grandes proborum virgines colonorum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.41
passages.text: Facto vocatur laetus opere vicinus;

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.42
passages.text: Nec avara servat crastinas dapes mensa,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.43
passages.text: Vescuntur omnes ebrioque non novit

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.44
passages.text: Satur minister invidere convivae.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.45
passages.text: At tu sub urbe possides famem mundam

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.46
passages.text: Et turre ab alta prospicis meras laurus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.47
passages.text: Furem Priapo non timente securus;

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.48
passages.text: Et vinitorem farre pascis urbano

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.49
passages.text: Pictamque portas otiosus ad villam

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.50
passages.text: Holus, ova, pullos, poma, caseum, mustum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.58.51
passages.text: Rus hoc vocari debet, an domus longe?

passages.label: Mart. 3.59.1
passages.text: Sutor Cerdo dedit tibi, culta Bononia, munus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.59.2
passages.text: Fullo dedit Mutinae: nunc ubi copo dabit?

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.1
passages.text: Cum vocer ad cenam non iam venalis ut ante,

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.2
passages.text: Cur mihi non eadem, quae tibi, cena datur?

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.3
passages.text: Ostrea tu sumis stagno saturata Lucrino,

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.4
passages.text: Sugitur inciso mitulus ore mihi:

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.5
passages.text: Sunt tibi boleti, fungos ego sumo suillos:

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.6
passages.text: Res tibi cum rhombost, at mihi cum sparulo:

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.7
passages.text: Aureus inmodicis turtur te clunibus implet,

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.8
passages.text: Ponitur in cavea mortua pica mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.9
passages.text: Cur sine te ceno, cum tecum, Pontice, cenem?

passages.label: Mart. 3.60.10
passages.text: Sportula quod non est, prosit: edamus idem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.61.1
passages.text: Esse nihil dicis quidquid petis, inprobe Cinna:

passages.label: Mart. 3.61.2
passages.text: Si nil, Cinna, petis, nil tibi, Cinna, nego.

passages.label: Mart. 3.62.1
passages.text: Centenis quod emis pueros et saepe ducenis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.62.2
passages.text: Quod sub rege Numa condita vina bibis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.62.3
passages.text: Quod constat decies tibi non spatiosa supellex,

passages.label: Mart. 3.62.4
passages.text: Libra quod argenti milia quinque rapit,

passages.label: Mart. 3.62.5
passages.text: Aurea quod fundi pretio carruca paratur,

passages.label: Mart. 3.62.6
passages.text: Quod pluris mula est, quam domus empta tibi:

passages.label: Mart. 3.62.7
passages.text: Haec animo credis magno te, Quinte, parare?

passages.label: Mart. 3.62.8
passages.text: Falleris: haec animus, Quinte, pusillus emit.

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.1
passages.text: Cotile, bellus homo es: dicunt hoc, Cotile, multi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.2
passages.text: Audio: sed quid sit, dic mihi, bellus homo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.3
passages.text: 'Bellus homo est, flexos qui digerit ordine crines,

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.4
passages.text: Balsama qui semper, cinnama semper olet;

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.5
passages.text: Cantica qui Nili, qui Gaditana susurrat,

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.6
passages.text: Qui movet in varios bracchia volsa modos;

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.7
passages.text: Inter femineas tota qui luce cathedras

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.8
passages.text: Desidet atque aliqua semper in aure sonat,

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.9
passages.text: Qui legit hinc illinc missas scribitque tabellas;

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.10
passages.text: Pallia vicini qui refugit cubiti;

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.11
passages.text: Qui scit, quam quis amet, qui per convivia currit,

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.12
passages.text: Hirpini veteres qui bene novit avos.'

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.13
passages.text: Quid narras? hoc est, hoc est homo, Cotile, bellus?

passages.label: Mart. 3.63.14
passages.text: Res pertricosa est, Cotile, bellus homo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.64.1
passages.text: Sirenas hilarem navigantium poenam

passages.label: Mart. 3.64.2
passages.text: Blandasque mortes gaudiumque crudele,

passages.label: Mart. 3.64.3
passages.text: Quas nemo quondam deserebat auditas,

passages.label: Mart. 3.64.4
passages.text: Fallax Ulixes dicitur reliquisse.

passages.label: Mart. 3.64.5
passages.text: Non miror: illud, Cassiane, mirarer,

passages.label: Mart. 3.64.6
passages.text: Si fabulantem Canium reliquisset.

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.1
passages.text: Quod spirat tenera malum mordente puella,

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.2
passages.text: Quod de Corycio quae venit aura croco;

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.3
passages.text: Vinea quod primis floret cum cana racemis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.4
passages.text: Gramina quod redolent, quae modo carpsit ovis;

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.5
passages.text: Quod myrtus, quod messor Arabs, quod sucina trita,

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.6
passages.text: Pallidus Eoo ture quod ignis olet;

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.7
passages.text: Glaeba quod aestivo leviter cum spargitur imbre,

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.8
passages.text: Quod madidas nardo passa corona comas:

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.9
passages.text: Hoc tua, saeve puer Diadumene, basia fragrant.

passages.label: Mart. 3.65.10
passages.text: Quid si tota dares illa sine invidia?

passages.label: Mart. 3.66.1
passages.text: Par scelus admisit Phariis Antonius armis:

passages.label: Mart. 3.66.2
passages.text: Abscidit voltus ensis uterque sacros.

passages.label: Mart. 3.66.3
passages.text: Illud, laurigeros ageres cum laeta triumphos,

passages.label: Mart. 3.66.4
passages.text: Hoc tibi, Roma, caput, cum loquereris, erat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.66.5
passages.text: Antoni tamen est peior, quam causa Pothini:

passages.label: Mart. 3.66.6
passages.text: Hic facinus domino praestitit, ille sibi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.1
passages.text: Cessatis, pueri, nihilque nostis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.2
passages.text: Vaterno Rasinaque pigriores,

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.3
passages.text: Quorum per vada tarda navigantes

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.4
passages.text: Lentos tinguitis ad celeuma remos.

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.5
passages.text: Iam prono Phaethonte sudat Aethon

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.6
passages.text: Exarsitque dies, et hora lassos

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.7
passages.text: Interiungit equos meridiana.

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.8
passages.text: At vos tam placidas vagi per undas

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.9
passages.text: Tuta luditis otium carina.

passages.label: Mart. 3.67.10
passages.text: Non nautas puto vos, sed Argonautas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.1
passages.text: Huc est usque tibi scriptus, matrona, libellus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.2
passages.text: Cui sint scripta, rogas, interiora? mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.3
passages.text: Gymnasium, thermae, stadium est hac parte: recede.

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.4
passages.text: Exuimur: nudos parce videre viros.

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.5
passages.text: Hinc iam deposito post vina rosasque pudore,

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.6
passages.text: Quid dicat, nescit saucia Terpsichore:

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.7
passages.text: Schemate nec dubio, sed aperte nominat illam,

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.8
passages.text: Quam recipit sexto mense superba Venus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.9
passages.text: Custodem medio statuit quam vilicus horto,

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.10
passages.text: Opposita spectat quam proba virgo manu.

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.11
passages.text: Si bene te novi, longum iam lassa libellum

passages.label: Mart. 3.68.12
passages.text: Ponebas, totum nunc studiosa leges.

passages.label: Mart. 3.69.1
passages.text: Omnia quod scribis castis epigrammata verbis

passages.label: Mart. 3.69.2
passages.text: Inque tuis nulla est mentula carminibus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.69.3
passages.text: Admiror, laudo; nihil est te sanctius uno:

passages.label: Mart. 3.69.4
passages.text: At mea luxuria pagina nulla vacat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.69.5
passages.text: Haec igitur nequam iuvenes facilesque puellae,

passages.label: Mart. 3.69.6
passages.text: Haec senior, sed quem torquet amica, legat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.69.7
passages.text: At tua, Cosconi, venerandaque sanctaque verba

passages.label: Mart. 3.69.8
passages.text: A pueris debent virginibusque legi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.70.1
passages.text: Moechus es Aufidiae, qui vir, Scaevine, fuisti;

passages.label: Mart. 3.70.2
passages.text: Rivalis fuerat qui tuus, ille vir est.

passages.label: Mart. 3.70.3
passages.text: Cur aliena placet tibi, quae tua non placet, uxor?

passages.label: Mart. 3.70.4
passages.text: Numquid securus non potes arrigere?

passages.label: Mart. 3.71.1
passages.text: Mentula cum doleat puero, tibi, Naevole, culus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.71.2
passages.text: Non sum divinus, sed scio quid facias.

passages.label: Mart. 3.72.1
passages.text: Vis futui, nec vis mecum, Saufeia, lavari.

passages.label: Mart. 3.72.2
passages.text: Nescio quod magnum suspicor esse nefas.

passages.label: Mart. 3.72.3
passages.text: Aut tibi pannosae dependent pectore mammae,

passages.label: Mart. 3.72.4
passages.text: Aut sulcos uteri prodere nuda times,

passages.label: Mart. 3.72.5
passages.text: Aut infinito lacerum patet inguen hiatu,

passages.label: Mart. 3.72.6
passages.text: Aut aliquid cunni prominet ore tui.

passages.label: Mart. 3.72.7
passages.text: Sed nihil est horum, credo, pulcherrima nuda es.

passages.label: Mart. 3.72.8
passages.text: Si verum est, vitium peius habes: fatua es.

passages.label: Mart. 3.73.1
passages.text: Dormis cum pueris mutuniatis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.73.2
passages.text: Et non stat tibi, Galle, quod stat illis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.73.3
passages.text: Quid vis me, rogo, Phoebe, suspicari?

passages.label: Mart. 3.73.4
passages.text: Mollem credere te virum volebam,

passages.label: Mart. 3.73.5
passages.text: Sed rumor negat esse te cinaedum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.74.1
passages.text: Psilothro faciem levas et dropace calvam.

passages.label: Mart. 3.74.2
passages.text: Numquid tonsorem, Gargiliane, times?

passages.label: Mart. 3.74.3
passages.text: Quid facient ungues? nam certe non potes illos

passages.label: Mart. 3.74.4
passages.text: Resina, Veneto nec resecare luto.

passages.label: Mart. 3.74.5
passages.text: Desine, si pudor est, miseram traducere calvam:

passages.label: Mart. 3.74.6
passages.text: Hoc fieri cunno, Gargiliane, solet.

passages.label: Mart. 3.75.1
passages.text: Stare, Luperce, tibi iam pridem mentula desi=t,

passages.label: Mart. 3.75.2
passages.text: Luctaris demens tu tamen arrigere.

passages.label: Mart. 3.75.3
passages.text: Sed nihil erucae faciunt bulbique salaces,

passages.label: Mart. 3.75.4
passages.text: Inproba nec prosunt iam satureia tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.75.5
passages.text: Coepisti puras opibus corrumpere buccas:

passages.label: Mart. 3.75.6
passages.text: Sic quoque non vivit sollicitata Venus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.75.7
passages.text: Mirari satis hoc quisquam vel credere possit,

passages.label: Mart. 3.75.8
passages.text: Quod non stat, magno stare, Luperce, tibi?

passages.label: Mart. 3.76.1
passages.text: Arrigis ad vetulas, fastidis, Basse, puellas,

passages.label: Mart. 3.76.2
passages.text: Nec formosa tibi, sed moritura placet.

passages.label: Mart. 3.76.3
passages.text: Hic, rogo, non furor est, non haec est mentula demens?

passages.label: Mart. 3.76.4
passages.text: Cum possis Hecaben, non potes Andromachen!

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.1
passages.text: Nec mullus nec te delectat, Baetice, turdus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.2
passages.text: Nec lepus est umquam nec tibi gratus aper,

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.3
passages.text: Nec te liba iuvant nec sectae quadra placentae,

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.4
passages.text: Nec Libye mittit nec tibi Phasis aves:

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.5
passages.text: Capparin et putri cepas hallece natantis

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.6
passages.text: Et pulpam dubio de petasone voras,

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.7
passages.text: Teque iuvant gerres et pelle melandrya cana,

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.8
passages.text: Resinata bibis vina, Falerna fugis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.9
passages.text: Nescio quod stomachi vitium secretius esse

passages.label: Mart. 3.77.10
passages.text: Suspicor: ut quid enim, Baetice, σαπροφαγεῖσ?

passages.label: Mart. 3.78.1
passages.text: Minxisti currente semel, Pauline, carina.

passages.label: Mart. 3.78.2
passages.text: Meiere vis iterum? iam Palinurus eris.

passages.label: Mart. 3.79.1
passages.text: Rem peragit nullam Sertorius, inchoat omnes.

passages.label: Mart. 3.79.2
passages.text: Hunc ego, cum futuit, non puto perficere.

passages.label: Mart. 3.80.1
passages.text: De nullo loqueris, nulli maledicis, Apici:

passages.label: Mart. 3.80.2
passages.text: Rumor ait linguae te tamen esse malae.

passages.label: Mart. 3.81.1
passages.text: Quid cum femineo tibi, Baetice Galle, barathro?

passages.label: Mart. 3.81.2
passages.text: Haec debet medios lambere lingua viros.

passages.label: Mart. 3.81.3
passages.text: Abscisa est quare Samia tibi mentula testa,

passages.label: Mart. 3.81.4
passages.text: Si tibi tam gratus, Baetice, cunnus erat?

passages.label: Mart. 3.81.5
passages.text: Castrandum caput est: nam sis licet inguine Gallus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.81.6
passages.text: Sacra tamen Cybeles decipis: ore vir es.

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.1
passages.text: Conviva quisquis Zoili potest esse,

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.2
passages.text: Summemmianas cenet inter uxores

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.3
passages.text: Curtaque Ledae sobrius bibat testa:

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.4
passages.text: Hoc esse levius puriusque contendo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.5
passages.text: Iacet occupato galbinatus in lecto

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.6
passages.text: Cubitisque trudit hinc et inde convivas

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.7
passages.text: Effultus ostro Sericisque pulvillis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.8
passages.text: Stat exoletus suggeritque ructanti

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.9
passages.text: Pinnas rubentes cuspidesque lentisci,

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.10
passages.text: Et aestuanti tenue ventilat frigus

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.11
passages.text: Supina prasino concubina flabello,

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.12
passages.text: Fugatque muscas myrtea puer virga.

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.13
passages.text: Percurrit agili corpus arte tractatrix

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.14
passages.text: Manumque doctam spargit omnibus membris;

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.15
passages.text: Digiti crepantis signa novit eunuchus

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.16
passages.text: Et delicatae sciscitator urinae

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.17
passages.text: Domini bibentis ebrium regit penem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.18
passages.text: At ipse retro flexus ad pedum turbam

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.19
passages.text: Inter catellas anserum exta lambentis

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.20
passages.text: Partitur apri glandulas palaestritis

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.21
passages.text: Et concubino turturum natis donat;

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.22
passages.text: Ligurumque nobis saxa cum ministrentur

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.23
passages.text: Vel cocta fumis musta Massilitanis,

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.24
passages.text: Opimianum morionibus nectar

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.25
passages.text: Crystallinisque murrinisque propinat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.26
passages.text: Et Cosmianis ipse fuscus ampullis

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.27
passages.text: Non erubescit murice aureo nobis

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.28
passages.text: Dividere moechae pauperis capillare.

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.29
passages.text: Septunce multo deinde perditus stertit:

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.30
passages.text: Nos accubamus et, silentium rhonchis

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.31
passages.text: Praestare iussi, nutibus propinamus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.32
passages.text: Hos Malchionis patimur inprobi fastus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.82.33
passages.text: Nec vindicari, Rufe, possumus: fellat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.83.1
passages.text: Ut faciam breviora mones epigrammata, Corde.

passages.label: Mart. 3.83.2
passages.text: 'Fac mihi, quod Chione': non potui brevius.

passages.label: Mart. 3.84.1
passages.text: Quid narrat tua moecha? Non puellam

passages.label: Mart. 3.84.2
passages.text: Dixi, Gongylion. Quid ergo? linguam.

passages.label: Mart. 3.85.1
passages.text: Quis tibi persuasit naris abscidere moecho?

passages.label: Mart. 3.85.2
passages.text: Non hac peccatum est parte, marite, tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.85.3
passages.text: Stulte, quid egisti? nihil hic tibi perdidit uxor,

passages.label: Mart. 3.85.4
passages.text: Cum sit salva tui mentula Deiphobi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.86.1
passages.text: Ne legeres partem lascivi, casta, libelli,

passages.label: Mart. 3.86.2
passages.text: Praedixi et monui: tu tamen, ecce, legis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.86.3
passages.text: Sed si Panniculum spectas et, casta, Latinum,—

passages.label: Mart. 3.86.4
passages.text: Non sunt haec mimis inprobiora—lege.

passages.label: Mart. 3.87.1
passages.text: Narrat te, Chione, rumor numquam esse fututam

passages.label: Mart. 3.87.2
passages.text: Atque nihil cunno purius esse tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.87.3
passages.text: Tecta tamen non hac, qua debes, parte lavaris:

passages.label: Mart. 3.87.4
passages.text: Si pudor est, transfer subligar in faciem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.88.1
passages.text: Sunt gemini fratres, diversa sed inguina lingunt.

passages.label: Mart. 3.88.2
passages.text: Dicite, dissimiles sunt magis, an similes?

passages.label: Mart. 3.89.1
passages.text: Utere lactucis et mollibus utere malvis:

passages.label: Mart. 3.89.2
passages.text: Nam faciem durum, Phoebe, cacantis habes.

passages.label: Mart. 3.90.1
passages.text: Volt, non volt dare Galla mihi, nec dicere possum,

passages.label: Mart. 3.90.2
passages.text: Quod volt et non volt, quid sibi Galla velit.

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.1
passages.text: Cum peteret patriae missicius arva Ravennae,

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.2
passages.text: Semiviro Cybeles cum grege iunxit iter.

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.3
passages.text: Huic comes haerebat domini fugitivus Achillas

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.4
passages.text: Insignis forma nequitiaque puer.

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.5
passages.text: Hoc steriles sensere viri: qua parte cubaret

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.6
passages.text: Quaerunt. Sed tacitos sensit et ille dolos:

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.7
passages.text: Mentitur, credunt. Somni post vina petuntur:

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.8
passages.text: Continuo ferrum noxia turba rapit

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.9
passages.text: Exciduntque senem, spondae qui parte iacebat;

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.10
passages.text: Namque puer pluteo vindice tutus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.11
passages.text: Subpositam quondam fama est pro virgine cervam,

passages.label: Mart. 3.91.12
passages.text: At nunc pro cervo mentula subposita est.

passages.label: Mart. 3.92.1
passages.text: Ut patiar moechum, rogat uxor, Galle, sed unum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.92.2
passages.text: Huic ego non oculos eruo, Galle, duos?

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.1
passages.text: Cum tibi trecenti consules, Vetustilla,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.2
passages.text: Et tres capilli quattuorque sint dentes,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.3
passages.text: Pectus cicadae, crus colorque formicae;

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.4
passages.text: Rugosiorem cum geras stola frontem

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.5
passages.text: Et araneorum cassibus pares mammas;

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.6
passages.text: Cum conparata rictibus tuis ora

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.7
passages.text: Niliacus habeat corcodilus angusta,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.8
passages.text: Meliusque ranae garriant Ravennates,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.9
passages.text: Et Atrianus dulcius culex cantet,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.10
passages.text: Videasque quantum noctuae vident mane,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.11
passages.text: Et illud oleas quod viri capellarum,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.12
passages.text: Et anatis habeas orthopygium macrae,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.13
passages.text: Senemque Cynicum vincat osseus cunnus;

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.14
passages.text: Cum te lucerna balneator extincta

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.15
passages.text: Admittat inter bustuarias moechas;

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.16
passages.text: Cum bruma mensem sit tibi per Augustum

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.17
passages.text: Regelare nec te pestilentia possit:

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.18
passages.text: Audes ducentas nuptuire post mortes

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.19
passages.text: Virumque demens cineribus tuis quaeris

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.20
passages.text: Prurire. Quid si Sattiae velit saxum?

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.21
passages.text: Quis coniugem te, quis vocabit uxorem,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.22
passages.text: Philomelus aviam quam vocaverat nuper?

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.23
passages.text: Quod si cadaver exigis tuum scalpi,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.24
passages.text: Sternatur Acori de triclinio lectus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.25
passages.text: Talassionem qui tuum decet solus,

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.26
passages.text: Ustorque taedas praeferat novae nuptae:

passages.label: Mart. 3.93.27
passages.text: Intrare in istum sola fax potest cunnum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.94.1
passages.text: Esse negas coctum leporem poscisque flagella.

passages.label: Mart. 3.94.2
passages.text: Mavis, Rufe, cocum scindere, quam leporem.

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.1
passages.text: Numquam dicis have, sed reddis, Naevole, semper,

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.2
passages.text: Quod prior et corvus dicere saepe solet.

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.3
passages.text: Cur hoc expectas a me, rogo, Naevole, dicas:

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.4
passages.text: Nam puto nec melior, Naevole, nec prior es.

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.5
passages.text: Praemia laudato tribuit mihi Caesar uterque

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.6
passages.text: Natorumque dedit iura paterna trium.

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.7
passages.text: Ore legor multo notumque per oppida nomen

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.8
passages.text: Non expectato dat mihi fama rogo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.9
passages.text: Est et in hoc aliquid: vidit me Roma tribunum

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.10
passages.text: Et sedeo qua te suscitat Oceanus.

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.11
passages.text: Quot mihi Caesareo facti sunt munere cives,

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.12
passages.text: Nec famulos totidem suspicor esse tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.13
passages.text: Sed pedicaris, sed pulchre, Naevole, ceves.

passages.label: Mart. 3.95.14
passages.text: Iam iam tu prior es, Naevole, vincis: have.

passages.label: Mart. 3.96.1
passages.text: Lingis, non futuis meam puellam

passages.label: Mart. 3.96.2
passages.text: Et garris quasi moechus et fututor.

passages.label: Mart. 3.96.3
passages.text: Si te prendero, Gargili, tacebis.

passages.label: Mart. 3.97.1
passages.text: Ne legat hunc Chione, mando tibi, Rufe, libellum.

passages.label: Mart. 3.97.2
passages.text: Carmine laesa meo est, laedere et illa potest.

passages.label: Mart. 3.98.1
passages.text: Sit culus tibi quam macer, requiris?

passages.label: Mart. 3.98.2
passages.text: Pedicare potes, Sabelle, culo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.99.1
passages.text: Irasci nostro non debes, Cerdo, libello.

passages.label: Mart. 3.99.2
passages.text: Ars tua, non vita est carmine laesa meo.

passages.label: Mart. 3.99.3
passages.text: Innocuos permitte sales. Cur ludere nobis

passages.label: Mart. 3.99.4
passages.text: Non liceat, licuit si iugulare tibi?

passages.label: Mart. 3.100.1
passages.text: Cursorem sexta tibi, Rufe, remisimus hora,

passages.label: Mart. 3.100.2
passages.text: Carmina quem madidum nostra tulisse reor:

passages.label: Mart. 3.100.3
passages.text: Imbribus inmodicis caelum nam forte ruebat.

passages.label: Mart. 3.100.4
passages.text: Non aliter mitti debuit iste liber.
